filter_note.note: Thursday of Week 7 (TNF NE@CHI live during pull). Loudest by count: CHI, NE, CIN (likely JD Vance visit noise; that story dropped), DAL, ATL, NO, SEA, PIT, PHI, HOU (HOU count inflated by college/other-Houston noise; no club items survived). Some club items were sourced from another club's pull when the story was about that club (ARI Jeremiyah Love, JAX Hunter, NE McDaniels/Vrabel, NYJ Breece Hall/Glenn, PHI Saquon/Sirianni). Dropped mostly other sports (World Series Brewers-Rays, NBA opening week, Knicks rings, WNBA Finals, NHL, F1 Austin, US Open Cup, Premier League), college football (Texas A&M-Alabama, Ole Miss-Texas, Georgia Tech, Miami throwbacks, Lobos uniforms, BYU, Vols, Arch Manning, Kincaid GameDay picker), uniform/meme items (Falcons throwback avatar, Browns brown pants, Herbert beer run, date-my-daughter tiers, Watson team party), JD Vance Bengals visit, Redskins name push, 2016 Mahomes-Mayfield nostalgia, broadcaster stories (Aikman-Buck, JJ Watt CBS), and many cross-club duplicates (49ers power rankings, Shipley OL list, primetime streaks, Colts sell-off).
